markets.rules_primary: If the number of transit calls through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 150 from Oct 5, 2026 to Oct 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The total is calculated by summing daily counts from Oct 5, 2026 to Oct 11, 2026. The market will resolve no earlier than Tuesday at 9 AM following the end of the period, once complete data is available.
markets.title: Will there be more than 150 transit calls through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from Oct 5, 2026 to Oct 11, 2026?
